instruction: I find automatic spell checking distracting while composing emails. Please disable the inline spell checker so that words are not underlined as I type.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling inline spell checking (mail.spellcheck.inline=false). Evaluator checks if the preference is set to false. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly identifies the target preference: mail.spellcheck.inline=false for disabling inline spell checking
Getter (vm_file) appropriately fetches the Thunderbird prefs.js file from the correct VM path
Metric (check_thunderbird_prefs) correctly parses prefs.js using regex and JSON, then compares the preference value against the expected rule
Expected value is semantically correct: the instruction asks to disable inline spell checker, and the evaluator checks for false value
Complete coverage: the single requirement (disable inline spell checker) is fully verified
Postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird and waits to ensure prefs.js is flushed to disk before verification
Data flow is logically sound: VM file extraction → preference parsing → boolean comparison
Edge case handling: metric returns 0.0 if file cannot be retrieved (None value)
No semantic or logical issues identified

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
